AN ACT to amend the alcoholic beverage control law, in relation to authorizing
special permits to remain open during certain hours of the morning
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S3274

SPONSOR: COONEY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the alcoholic beverage control law, in relation to
authorizing special permits to remain open during certain hours of the
morning

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill would allow restaurants and bars to apply for a special permit
to stay open on January 1 between 4 am and 10 am.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Allows licensees to apply for a special permit to stay open
on the morning of January 1 from 4 a.m. to 8 a.m.

Section 2. Establishes effective date

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation will allow bars and restaurants to stay open on New
Year's Eve when New Year's Eve is on a weekend in the same manner they
would if New Year's Eve fell on a weekday. Currently, New York law
allows an alcohol serving bar or restaurant to apply for a permit to
stay open past traditional hours if New Year's Eve is a weekday. This
bill would extend that permit for when New Year's Eve falls on a week-
end.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: 2023-24: S4742A

2022: S6133 - Passed the Senate

2021: S6133 - Died on the Senate calendar

2020: S829 - Referred to Investigations and Government Operations

2019: S829 - Referred to Investigations and Government Operations

2018: S3945-A - Committed to Rules

2017: S3945-A - Passed the Senate

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the sixtieth day after it shall have
become law
